fixture_policy: Production renderers, deterministic synthetic public identities, no action dispatch, network, native vault, host service, cloud resources, PSRP or recording workers. Headless UI evidence is not native qualification.

groups.route: Command palette → Dev Tunnel: Set up a host…; or Profiles → New Profile → Dev Tunnel → Set up a host… → choose platform/options
groups.exit: Back returns to the profile list without installing or executing anything. View script opens a read-only embedded installer tab; close that tab to return. Copy command/script requires a separate explicit action, never dispatched during capture.
groups.notes: All three platform field sets and pinned commands; Linux dependency choice; upgrade disables friendly-name editing and can refuse takeover. HostSetup has no inline validation/error state: the production generator escapes metadata into the command rather than executing it.

groups.route: Profiles → New Profile → Dev Tunnel · Experimental; or saved Dev Tunnel row → Edit → Advanced → optional Use destination file; Save stages validation and transactional persistence
groups.exit: Cancel or Back discards the staged draft without connecting or mutating an existing session. Collapse Advanced without changing metadata. Correct invalid fields or explicitly retry a failed Save; pending Save never claims success or connects automatically.
groups.notes: New and saved editors, immutable saved name, native tunnel/account controls, expanded legacy public destination/scoped-token controls, actual build validation, pending save and retained-draft persistence error. No token, account grant, credential lookup, file access or command dispatch.

groups.route: Profiles → New Profile → PowerShell; or saved PowerShell row → Edit → HTTPS/NTLM or SSH subsystem → exact endpoint/trust/source fields → Save validation
groups.exit: Cancel discards staged metadata and clears the password widget. Correct invalid port or missing SSH pin and explicitly Save again. Endpoint changes require password re-entry; saving metadata never connects or falls back to another transport/configuration.
groups.notes: Separate from the runtime tab: basic new form, populated custom HTTPS/domain/CA/Ask-source fields, pinned SSH subsystem, actual build errors and endpoint-changed credential reset warning. This editor has no collapsed Advanced section; its transport-specific fields are directly visible. Synthetic CA/destination strings are never opened; all password fields remain empty.

groups.route: Recording menu → Recording settings → enable typing normalization, burst limits and progressive reveal; edit naming template or open Font/Theme/playback-speed selector
groups.exit: Cancel discards draft settings. Escape dismisses an open selector. Correct an invalid template before Save; choosing a preview option never records or exports anything.
groups.notes: Conditional numeric controls, invalid template feedback and all export selector popups use the production editor.

groups.route: Recording menu → Start recording → no active terminals, Include new sessions or One-recording export options; active recording → Include sessions with no further eligible rows
groups.exit: Cancel returns without recording or changing inclusion. Uncheck Include new sessions to withdraw that draft choice. Close the empty inclusion dialog without mutating recording membership.
groups.notes: No-target admission refusal, explicit future-session/integrity warning, expanded per-recording options and no-additional-session state.

groups.route: Settings → Local MCP → Controller registrations before this process has opted in → inspect explicit Enable controller registration for new connections
groups.exit: Leave Settings without enabling. Opt-in alone would not associate a terminal or approve observation/input; existing connections cannot silently upgrade.
groups.notes: Displays only the real registration opt-in surface; no registration approval is dispatched.

groups.route: Settings → JavaScript workflows → explicit reviewed Run starts isolated worker; queued exact input/refusal notice; captured source → Next source page → final page
groups.exit: Stop workflow fences subsequent admission without undoing previously admitted input. Cancel exact input refuses that proposal. Previous source page or collapse returns from read-only source review.
groups.notes: Starting worker status, queued-input count/refusal notice and disabled Next on the final source page; no JavaScript executes.

groups.route: Settings → Remote access · this device → eligible attached persistent shell → Review exact generation
groups.exit: Leave Settings without selecting a session, or retain it privately. Merely seeing an eligible row does not Bind, Switch or grant exposure.
groups.notes: Synthetic exact-generation selection row. Successful private Bind remains blocked on authenticated connected-local source capability.

groups.route: INTERNAL ONLY: OpenEnterpriseDiscovery → foreground sign-in/discovery → empty, project-denied or bounded inventory
groups.exit: INTERNAL ONLY: Sign out and clear discards transient inventory; Close/tab close retains worker cleanup ownership. A subsequent discovery requires a new explicit sign-in.
groups.notes: Empty resources, project authorization denial, omitted rows and queries deliberately not fetched after the display budget.

groups.route: Recording library → retained complete/incomplete/empty source, orphan options or staging; completed source → Export → Calculate duration
groups.exit: Close leaves the library without modifying data. Keep source for later closes export and retains private data; cancellation of actual preview/export never claims publication.
groups.notes: Pure display projections feed the same production row/dialog renderer. Export scenes scroll to the footer: calculating shows the spinner and disabled Export; ready shows 42.0-second duration and enabled Export. No RecordingSource, storage lease, artifact, staging file, preview task or encoder is manufactured. Actions still require real coordinator-owned library/preview state.

groups.route: Settings → Local MCP → Controller registrations → choice/association/metadata/input review → target disappears, list is incomplete, originating window differs or review is revoked
groups.exit: Cancel controller selection, Cancel metadata review or Cancel requested input refuses that proposal. Return to the originating window and explicitly choose/review current targets. Disarm/revoke stops later admission, not already admitted input.
groups.notes: Real in-memory broker snapshot fixture, missing/incomplete public target lists and existing review invalidation methods. No native approval is applied.

groups.route: Settings → JavaScript workflows → captured multi-module bundle → expand capabilities/parameters/source → module selector or next page → explicit parameter-bearing Run review
groups.exit: Collapse disclosures or Clear workflow preview without executing. Correct invalid fields or select an eligible local terminal before a new explicit review; Stop workflow ends any actual active run without undoing previously admitted input.
groups.notes: ApprovedBundle validates token-safe manifest, sorted/reachable static modules and typed parameters. Every text/integer/boolean/target parameter widget, range/length refusal, source-page and module popup is rendered without running JavaScript.

groups.route: Profiles → HOST recipe → Review and connect → retained original-action presentation or explicit AlwaysCreate/AttachOnly recipe behavior
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape closes review without replaying or replacing the original action. Review the same current binding again; a resolved-but-unpresented response is not permission to create another shell.
groups.notes: Test-only public display data feeds the production original-action text/warning; no CreationIntent, protected receipt, granted owner context or actual request is manufactured.

groups.route: Saved legacy Dev Tunnel → Connect → different host fingerprint; account-save flow → explicit host trust without connecting
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape refuses proposed trust. Independently investigate changed host identity before reconnecting; closing never saves a changed trust decision.
groups.notes: Previous/proposed synthetic public fingerprints and Save account-only action; no credential lookup, device sign-in or connection.

groups.route: Profiles → Host/session recipes → Import malformed/reviewed public JSON or edit Temporary/AttachOnly/AlwaysCreate/ResumeOrCreate metadata
groups.exit: Cancel abandons the staged import/editor and returns to recipes. Correct malformed JSON or generation fields and review again. Metadata save/import never executes a recipe or ends a shell.
groups.notes: All conditional metadata field sets and explicit reviewed-import state, using the existing production editor. Intentional visual equivalence: host-recipes-edit-resume is pixel-identical to host-recipes-edit because PublicRecipe::persistent already defaults to ConnectionBehavior::ResumeOrCreate. The explicit behavior scene documents that default rather than pretending it is a separate widget surface.

groups.route: Settings → Remote access · this device → Advanced · explicit signed local bundle → Use manually selected signed files
groups.exit: Uncheck the explicit manual-bundle choice or leave Settings without confirming Enable. Collapse Advanced to hide its fields. Neither leaving nor collapsing installs, approves or cleans up anything.
groups.notes: Explicit manual alternative with synthetic inert paths; selecting it is never an acquisition or verification failure fallback.

groups.route: Settings → Remote access · this device → explicit status refresh / Review action / separate Confirm
groups.exit: Not now dismisses an installation review. During work use Cancel and fence mutating work and wait for actual revocation/drain. Leaving Settings only hides the surface; it does not disable access or prove cleanup. Preserve uncertain original sharing operations; Refresh and explicitly review recovery or authenticated cleanup again. Release keeps the shell; rollback is an explicit irreversible unshare.
groups.notes: All lifecycle phases, installation confirmations, acquisition stages, typed refusals and original-operation share status controls. Separate eligible-row scene captures exact-session selection. Sharing fixtures deliberately have no authenticated connected-local source and therefore show capability refusal; a real native source remains required for successful Bind.

groups.route: Profiles → Host/session recipes · Experimental → recipe → Review and connect…
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape closes foreground HOST review without connecting or replaying input. Local owner-key preparation may already have completed: reopen and explicitly reload the same protected receipt. Uncertain creation retains its original action; closing review is not absence, deletion or replacement consent.
groups.notes: First-connect binding entry, explicit attestation, bounded worker, vault refusal, public owner-key disclosure, empty/Unknown inventory, available/busy session rows and exact persistent/temporary creation consent. Test-only public owner display data feeds the same production renderer, without manufacturing a protected receipt, private key or runnable client context.

groups.route: Profiles → Add Dev Tunnel / account browser → Browse my tunnels → optional Rename / Delete
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape cancels working/device-flow browsing; Close exits a completed list or error. Rename Cancel returns to the list; deletion Keep refuses deletion. Closing never grants host trust or connects a shell.
groups.notes: Legacy bridge discovery only; device code is synthetic DEMO-CODE. Delete defaults to Cancel.

groups.route: Launcher or Profiles → legacy Dev Tunnel profile → Connect → explicit GitHub device sign-in → host trust
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape cancels pending connection or refuses host trust; an error offers Close. Return to the profile and reconnect explicitly after correcting the account, storage or host identity. Do not approve a changed fingerprint merely to clear the error.
groups.notes: No sign-in or bridge launch; synthetic public host key and device code only.

groups.route: Profiles → locally hosted persistent profile → New shell / Recreate missing tunnel; Settings hosted inventory → Revoke unreferenced exposure
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape dismisses new-shell, recreate-tunnel or unreferenced-cleanup confirmation without starting a shell, recreating exposure or removing resources. Return to Profiles or Settings to inspect and review the exact current binding again.
groups.notes: Controller disabled for capture, so polling cannot enumerate local state or launch workers. Persistent shells are never started, killed or replaced.

groups.route: Profiles → add/edit Local profile → expose through Dev Tunnel → Choose GitHub account
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape returns to the staged Local profile editor without verified account consent. In-flight account work is cancelled; a sign-in already completed in the external browser can remain with the CLI. Retry account check is explicit; incompatible existing exposures must be reconciled before changing accounts.
groups.notes: Verified synthetic account, waiting, signed-out, incompatible binding and unavailable verified-helper states.

groups.route: Profiles → Host/session recipes · Experimental → Add / Edit / Copy / Delete / Import / Export
groups.exit: Cancel abandons an unsaved editor, duplicate, import or deletion review and returns to recipes. Export uses Back to recipes; the list uses Back to Profiles. A failed save keeps the staged metadata for correction or cancellation. Deleting metadata never ends the remote shell.
groups.notes: Offline metadata only; import review is unverified and unchecked; copy/deletion never grants access or ends a shell.

groups.route: INTERNAL ONLY: OpenEnterpriseDiscovery command → tenant/client/Dev Center setup → Sign in and discover. Product GUI entry points are deliberately hidden pending owner approval.
groups.exit: INTERNAL ONLY: Cancel sign-in cancels SigningIn/Discovering and waits for worker cleanup. Inventory offers Sign out and clear or Close; tab close retains cleanup ownership until workers finish. Failed/Closed setup requires a new explicit sign-in. These fixtures do not imply a discoverable public launcher entry.
groups.notes: Implemented internal surface, not a user-discoverable released entry point. Valid synthetic Azure Dev Center draft and read-only project/Dev Box rows; Failed and Closed reuse the same setup controls intentionally, while the production event list distinguishes discovery failure from completed worker cleanup. No identity, discovery or remote-desktop workers.

groups.route: Settings → enable experimental PowerShell → Profiles → PowerShell profile → Connect → Run / Cancel
groups.exit: Cancel connection refuses a pending connection. Stop requests cancellation of a running pipeline; Close or tab close waits for owned runspace cleanup and may require the app's active-session confirmation. Failed/Closed returns to setup for an explicit new connection, never automatic command replay.
groups.notes: Structured output/warning events and setup/connect/run/cancel/error presentation; no password or PSRP transport.

groups.route: Settings → Recording defaults; terminal recording action → Start / Include sessions / Stop and export; Recording library → Retry / Recover / Delete
groups.exit: Cancel or Escape dismisses Start/Include; Close leaves settings or library. Export Keep source for later retains private data; retry Back and deletion Cancel return to the library. Active Stop recording finalizes capture; Cancel preparation/export stops that work without claiming publication. Incomplete sources remain for explicit recovery or deletion; Dismiss only hides an idle status notice.
groups.notes: Every dialog variant and deletion kind. Native privacy admission is intentionally absent, so Start remains disabled. No source, staging file, video encoder or native folder picker is created.

groups.route: Settings → Local MCP (Beta) → connection code / exact attachment consent; Controller registrations → Choose terminal → Confirm association → independent metadata or requested-input review
groups.exit: Reject direct MCP connection or Disconnect/Revoke this MCP connection closes its access. Cancel controller selection, Cancel metadata review and Cancel requested input reject the corresponding review; revoke metadata, Disarm terminal control or Unregister controller end later authority. Cancellation/disarm cannot undo already admitted input. Merely leaving Settings does not revoke a grant.
groups.notes: In-memory broker fixtures only. No listener or grant is applied by capture; text/keys, disarm, cancellation and possible-admission warnings use real presentation.

groups.route: Settings → JavaScript workflows (Beta) → Select workflow JSON → captured source/capability review → privacy monitoring → explicit Run → separate per-input consent / Stop
groups.exit: Clear workflow preview abandons captured-source review without granting execution. Deny rejects the displayed input; Stop workflow ends the active run. A capture still cancelling must finish before another read starts. Leaving Settings does not itself stop an existing run, and stopping never undoes already admitted terminal input.
groups.notes: Frozen in-memory source snapshot only; no file picker, JavaScript worker, shell input or broker disclosure.

groups.route: Profiles → New Profile → Dev Tunnel → Host dropdown, with two signed-in GitHub accounts
groups.exit: Choosing a host only fills the draft; Escape or clicking away closes the dropdown. Cancel/Back discards the draft without saving or connecting.
groups.notes: Hosts are grouped under each signed-in account. Refreshing shows bounded parallel per-account discovery in flight; stale shows one account's discovery error while the other account's hosts remain selectable. Synthetic accounts only; no discovery request is sent.

groups.route: Profiles → New Profile → Dev Tunnel → choose host → Existing session selector or Create session if missing
groups.exit: Selecting an existing session or typing a new name only edits the draft; Cancel/Back discards it. Save is a separate explicit action, never dispatched during capture.
groups.notes: The existing-session selector lists remembered authorized sessions. Create session if missing explicitly reveals an editable required name; both new and saved profiles permit deliberate host/session edits. The historical session-locked image ID now shows editable saved metadata.

implemented_egui_gaps.route: Settings → Remote access → eligible attached persistent shell → exact sharing review
implemented_egui_gaps.missing: Only authenticated-source Confirm Bind privately remains uncaptured. Eligible-session selection and every prepared/active/revoked/released/uncertain status/recovery surface have scenes.
implemented_egui_gaps.prerequisite: A live authenticated connected-local LocalSessionTarget capability from the actual native daemon, with the exact current session generation and current protected native-vault owner policy. Neither metadata/PID nor a fabricated source token is acceptable.
implemented_egui_gaps.classification: Blocked capability-bound evidence, not an omitted constructible display model.

native_only_gaps: Actual protected HOST receipt reopening and successful authorized attachment/creation require native vault/private-index composition. The public owner-key pane and inventory/creation rendering are captured using test-only public display data; no fake receipt is passed as protected approval.

Successful exact connected-local Bind needs authenticated native source capability; fixtures show refusals and all independently presented sharing status/recovery controls without manufacturing that capability.

System GitHub browser, OS vault/unlock, enterprise browser/device identity, native folder picker, helper registration, lock/privacy dialogs and cloud/provider cleanup UI are external native surfaces, not headless egui renders.
Real tunnel readiness, signed release availability, native Windows/macOS/Linux manager behavior, actual recording/export and installed-device qualification remain unclaimed.
